findings.title: Budget notification is disabled: monthly-cloud-budget
findings.description: Budget coverage, alerting, actual spend, forecast, or cost trend is outside the configured FinOps policy.
findings.recommendation: Enable the notification or remove it if it is intentionally obsolete, then validate the remaining escalation path.

findings.title: Budget lacks required alert thresholds: monthly-cloud-budget
findings.description: Budget coverage, alerting, actual spend, forecast, or cost trend is outside the configured FinOps policy.
findings.recommendation: Add progressive actual and forecast notifications so teams can respond before the budget is exhausted.

findings.title: Budget is exceeded: monthly-cloud-budget
findings.description: Budget coverage, alerting, actual spend, forecast, or cost trend is outside the configured FinOps policy.
findings.recommendation: Investigate the largest cost drivers immediately, freeze nonessential expansion, and document the approved remediation or budget change.

findings.title: Forecast exceeds budget: monthly-cloud-budget
findings.description: Budget coverage, alerting, actual spend, forecast, or cost trend is outside the configured FinOps policy.
findings.recommendation: Review the forecast inputs and largest services, then implement approved optimization or update the budget with accountable ownership.

findings.title: Recent daily cloud spend increased sharply
findings.description: Budget coverage, alerting, actual spend, forecast, or cost trend is outside the configured FinOps policy.
findings.recommendation: Correlate the increase with deployments, data transfer, scale events, new regions, and anomalous resource creation.

findings.title: Cloud spend is concentrated in one service: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud
